CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_launch_count_by_year()
RETURNS TABLE(launch_year integer, launch_count bigint) AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM launchmoment::date)::integer AS launch_year,
           COUNT(*)::bigint AS launch_count
    FROM show_rollups
    WHERE launchmoment IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM launchmoment::date)
    ORDER BY launch_year;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
